headline: Executive order creating a presidential board focused on employment of people with disabilities.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order set up a group called the President's Disability Employment Partnership Board. The title suggests the board's work centers on jobs for people with disabilities, likely through partnerships. No summary was provided, so details about the board's members, duties, and powers are not available here.

who_it_affects.group: People with disabilities who are looking for work or are employed
who_it_affects.how: The board named in the title appears focused on employment issues that affect them.
The word "partnership" in the title suggests the board may work with employers, but the source material does not say how.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 10, 2001; executive orders usually take effect when signed, but the provided material does not state the date.
